name: Mode field
summary: A labelled field with an inline exclusive mode control whose body swaps in place — the settings field for a control that has two-or-more mutually-exclusive modes.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-mode-field> — for a setting whose control has two-or-more EXCLUSIVE modes (an automatic/manual switch, a value-source switch): a label with an inline segmented mode control, and a body that swaps IN PLACE as the mode changes. The bodies are the element's own light-DOM children (persistent nodes) tagged `data-mode`; switching mode only toggles their `hidden`, never rebuilds them — so the active body keeps its state and the mode buttons' transition fires. The segmented buttons are an honest group of aria-pressed buttons (exclusive selection without faking a roving radiogroup). Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. Emits composed `change` CustomEvent<{mode}>.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. Modes are set as a property (`el.modes = [...]`) or a JSON `modes` attribute; bodies are light-DOM children with `data-mode`. React (< 19) via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds natively.

whenToUse.when: a single setting whose control has 2+ exclusive modes and a mode-specific body (automatic vs manual, value-source A vs B)
an exclusive choice with NO mode-specific body to swap
a plain immediate on/off with no modes

opinion.note: Only the active mode's body is live — the others stay in the DOM (persistent) but hidden, so switching back restores their state. A mode toggle for an action may keep a verb-led label ('Show results manually') per SETTINGS-01.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the settings-lab ModeField control mapped into the DS. The segmented mode control reuses the DS V3 segmented family; the label + inline-mode layout and the swap-in-place persistent body are the settings-specific shape.
